discovery.pool_universe: SOL-paired, non-blacklisted, TVL>=50000 USD, 24h volume>=25000 USD
discovery.selection: recent finalized DLMM LP actors only; no PnL or outcome data

additional_diagnostics: largest winning position share of total PnL
rank_outputs: robust ROI rank after preregistered minimum-history gates

interpretation: This is a bounded active-universe evaluation, not a claim to identify every profitable wallet on Solana.
No strategy may be frozen from discovery data before the cohort is frozen.
No strategy threshold or ranking rule may be altered after PnL is observed merely to promote a wallet.
The existing exploratory wallet-cluster prospective experiment remains separate and unchanged.
